rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Inseegoが10-Kで、5G製品の顧客の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Inseego names Fastenal among customers for its 5G products

source.label: Inseego 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our customers for our 5G products include Verizon Wireless, T-Mobile, EnerNOC, Thermo Fisher Scientific, US Army and Fastenal, amongst others.

companies.name: ダルラダ
companies.sub: 製造・技術の持株会社

relations.text: Dalradaの製造子会社がFastenalからの発注で取引(訴訟の記載)
relations.text_en: Dalrada Manufacturing had a contractual relationship filling Fastenal purchase orders (per a lawsuit)

source.label: Dalrada Financial 10-K(2024年6月期)
source.quote: to steal Fastenal Company purchase orders and effectively try to cut Dalrada Manufacturing out of its contractual relationship.

companies.name: イノベーティブ・アイウェア

relations.text: 安全用スマート眼鏡の販路として狙う大手PPE卸の一社に挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Fastenal among the PPE distributors its safety eyewear sales strategy targets

source.label: Innovative Eyewear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our distribution strategy targets major home improvement retailers including Home Depot, Lowe's, Ace Hardware, and Canadian Tire, as well as leading industrial PPE (personal protective equipment) distributors such as Grainger and Fastenal.

companies.name: ジェニュイン・パーツ

relations.text: Genuine Partsが10-Kで、産業部品流通の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Genuine Parts names Fastenal a competitor in industrial distribution

source.label: Genuine Parts 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In industrial distribution, our main competitor is Applied Industrial Technologies, Inc., but we also compete against Fastenal Company, and W.W. Grainger, Inc, among many other smaller, regional competitors.

companies.name: グローバル・インダストリアル

relations.text: Global Industrialが10-Kで、大手MRO卸の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Global Industrial names Fastenal among large MRO distributor competitors

source.label: Global Industrial 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: We face competition from large diversified MRO distributors such as Uline Inc, Grainger Inc., MSC Industrial Direct Inc., Fastenal Inc., and other large retailers, including Amazon.
